box_vector: [present, min(n,5)/5, largest fraction, best confidence, cx, cy, w, h of the largest person box]
claim_scope: rung 2b's four arms x two person-modes at LFM2.5-VL-450M on the s2042 door; 200 eval frames, one door seed

rule.note: rung 1's PRESENT rule on COCO uses the annotation's mask area; a box is never smaller than its mask, so the detector's side of the rule is the looser one
rule.present: any `person` box with confidence >= 0.25 whose box area is >= 5% of the frame

training.head: none: a rule over the person boxes
training.note: COCO val2017 is the detector's own validation split; no frame here was trained on

rule.present: at least one non-crowd person annotation with box area >= 5% of the image

lie.rule: absent frames: a present eval frame's vector by random.Random(2026); present frames: zeros
